notes.title: Update 0.2.1
notes.content:
New Feature: Inventory has been re-worked to fit better an RPG style game.
New Feature: Ability casting is instant, and when holding a key button it can be targeted. This gives players more control, but also makes it easy for quick actions.
New Feature: Ready button for Co-Op.
New Feature: Enemy decals are colored RED and player and allies are colored BLUE.
Improvements: Controller Support.
Fix: Dropship hover UI
Fix: Arria Special ability 1 casting multiple times.
Fix: In-game session "Esc" button to pause.
Fix: Slow-down time at the end of game sessions.
